capabilities: Insert markup and wikilink templates with Alt shortcuts and Tab through link parts
Jump between the starts and ends of adjacent lines with repeat on hold
Extend the selection one character in either direction while keeping the anchor
Clear the current line in two stages and discard pending IME composition safely
Go back and forward between notes while restoring each note's scroll position
extras: Desktop app only (isDesktopOnly: true) and requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer. No settings tab, no data file, no network access; some keys cannot be remapped because they are handled on raw keydown. README is duplicated in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no Alt-layer editing shortcuts, so moving the mouse to insert symbols or jump lines takes multiple steps, and going back to a note lands at the top instead of the previous scroll position.

relations.evidence: Keys must be caught before CodeMirror sees them.

summary: Alt-key editing shortcuts that insert markup, jump between lines, extend selections character by character, fill wikilink templates, and navigate history.
